# `nlink-lab render`

## Reference

<!-- cli-ref:start (generated by `nlink-lab docs-gen`; do not edit) -->

```text
A topology file with every loop, variable and import expanded: flat NLL, the topology as JSON (`--format json`), or a diagram (`--diagram dot|mermaid|ascii`)

Usage: nlink-lab render [OPTIONS] <TOPOLOGY>

Arguments:
  <TOPOLOGY>
          Path to the topology file (.nll)

Options:
      --diagram <DIAGRAM>
          A diagram of it instead of the flat NLL

          Possible values:
          - dot:     A Graphviz DOT graph (`| dot -Tsvg`)
          - mermaid: A Mermaid `graph LR` block (renders inline in Forgejo/GitHub markdown)
          - ascii:   A text drawing

      --set <KEY=VALUE>
          Set NLL parameters (can be repeated: --set key=value)

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
```

<!-- cli-ref:end -->
